;Disasters and accidents
*A large number of [[fireworks]] accidentally go off in a barge at a [[New Year's Day]] show in [[Terrigal]], [[New South Wales|NSW]], [[Australia]], causing thousands to be evacuated from the beach by police and the two people on the barge to suffer minor injuries. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-australia-42531996 (BBC)]
*A truck collision in western [[Kenya]] kills at least 36 people and injures 18. [https://www.standardmedia.co.ke/article/2001264584/at-least-30-dead-18-hurt-in-migaa-bus-truck-collision ''(The Standard)'']
*[[2017 Sydney Seaplanes crash]]
**A [[De Havilland Canada DHC-2 Beaver|DHC-2 Beaver]] seaplane crashes into the [[Hawkesbury River]] near [[Sydney]], killing at least six people. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-australia-42527530 (BBC)] [https://www.ctvnews.ca/world/dozens-killed-in-head-on-collision-between-bus-and-truck-in-kenya-1.3740658 (CTV NEWS)]
*[[2017 Nature Air Cessna 208 Caravan crash]]
**Twelve people, including all 10 American passengers, are killed when their single-propeller plane crashes in a mountainous area near Punta Islita, in [[Guanacaste Province]], [[Costa Rica]]. The pilot was former President [[Laura Chinchilla]]'s cousin. [https://www.cbsnews.com/news/costa-rica-plane-crash-several-dead-live-updates/ (CBS News)] [http://www.ticotimes.net/2017/12/31/plane-crash-causes-still-unknown-in-costa-rica-pilot-was-cousin-to-ex-president-chinchilla (AFP and ''The Tico Times'')]
*A [[Vehicle fire|fire]] consumes a multi-story parking garage in [[Liverpool]], [[England]], destroying about 1,400 cars parked there, most for an international [[horse show]] in the adjacent [[Echo Arena Liverpool|Liverpool Echo Arena]]. No injuries are reported, and all horses and pet dogs were moved to safety. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-britain-fire/blaze-destroys-hundreds-of-cars-melts-floors-of-liverpool-parking-garage-idUSKBN1EQ163 (Reuters)] [https://www.cbsnews.com/news/u-k-parking-garage-fire-destroys-1400-cars/ (AP and CBS News)]

;International relations
*[[Secretary-General of the United Nations|United Nations Secretary-General]] [[António Guterres]] issues "a red alert for our world," saying that conflicts have deepened, global anxieties about [[nuclear weapon]]s have increased, inequalities have grown, and [[nationalism]] and [[xenophobia]] are on the rise. Guterres calls for global unity to overcome these growing challenges. [http://www.cnn.com/2017/12/31/us/un-secretary-general-2018-message-intl/index.html (CNN)]

;Law and crime
*[[Copper Canyon Apartment Homes shooting]]
**Five [[Douglas County, Colorado|Douglas County]], [[Colorado]] sheriff's deputies are shot, one fatally, and two civilians are injured at a domestic disturbance call. The suspect was also killed. [https://www.cbsnews.com/news/colorado-shooting-douglas-county-highlands-ranch-denver-today-live-updates/ (CBS News)]
*[[Law of China]]
**China announces that its [[ivory trade]] is now illegal. In 2015, [[President of the People's Republic of China|Mainland Chinese President]] [[Xi Jinping]] and then-[[President of the United States|U.S. President]] [[Barack Obama]] announced "near-complete" ivory bans for each country. America's [[ivory]] ban went into effect in June 2016. [https://news.nationalgeographic.com/2017/12/wildlife-watch-china-ivory-ban-goes-into-effect/ (''National Geographic'')]

;Politics and elections
*[[Politics of India]]
**Indian film superstar [[Rajinikanth]], who has a huge following in the country and is one of Asia's highest paid actors, has announced he is entering politics. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-asia-india-42527290 (BBC)]
*[[2017 Iranian protests]]
**[[Iran]] blocks access to [[Telegram (messaging service)|Telegram]] and [[Instagram]] as the largest anti-government protests [[2009 Iranian presidential election protests|since 2009]] continue. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2017/dec/31/protesters-who-spread-fear-and-violence-will-be-confronted-says-iran (''The Guardian'')]
*[[Palestine–United States relations]]
**Palestine recalls its envoy to the United States for "consultations," following [[President of the United States|President]] [[Donald Trump|Trump's]] recognition of [[Jerusalem]] as the capital of Israel. [[President of the State of Palestine|Palestinian President]] [[Mahmoud Abbas]] says that he will not accept any U.S. [[List of Middle East peace proposals|peace plan]] in the wake of Trump's move. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-42531102 (BBC)]

;Sports
*[[2017 NFL season]], [[2017 Cleveland Browns season]]
**In [[American football]], the [[2017 Cleveland Browns season|Cleveland Browns]] becomes the second team in the [[National Football League|NFL]], along with the [[2008 Detroit Lions season|Detroit Lions]] to have a winless season. [https://www.washingtonpost.com/news/early-lead/wp/2017/12/31/bumbling-browns-complete-0-16-season-in-fitting-fashion/ (''The Washington Post'')]
